description: Find which country and network an IP address belongs to, for fraud checks, geo-compliance or log enrichment. Looks up 1-50 IPv4/IPv6 addresses: country, ASN and organisation, network range and private/reserved detection, from a monthly local copy of DB-IP Lite, so no IP is sent to third parties. Country-level only; VPNs and proxies are not detected. Use when a decision depends on where a request or login comes from. $0.001 per call, USDC on Base (x402).

ip.description: IPv4/IPv6 address, or up to 50 comma-separated

payment_signature.description: x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header value. Omit to receive payment requirements.

name: ip_lookup
